pages.text: $(o)A dragon of embers roosting atop a ruined tower, guarded by burning skeletons.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() It sets the ground alight and rains fireballs. Clear its guards first, then fight on stone, never in the flames.$(br2)Fire resistance turns this fight around.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Cinder Scale$() counts for the quest book. Its bones make the Dragon Bone armor.
